A1.justification: Both PDFs describe IDESplat and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and supplementary Sections A–D. Corresponding content can be matched reliably across relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction, cross-dataset generalization, efficiency, and ablation results, including DL3DV experiments in the supplement.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experiments and adds quantitative ScanNet depth-estimation results and qualitative depth-error comparisons.

M1.justification: The backbone, DPBUs, GFM, and losses are retained. Section 3.2 now specifies signed residual offsets and an interval schedule I_n = I_1/n, while Section 4.3 retains range-halving language. The PDFs do not resolve whether the refinement procedure changed or its previous mathematical description was corrected.

E1.justification: v3 adds ScanNet depth-estimation evaluation in Section 4.2. RealEstate10K, ACID, DTU, and supplementary DL3DV coverage, including the existing multiple-input-view scenarios, are retained.

E2.justification: UniMatch becomes an evaluated comparator in the new ScanNet Table 4 and Figure 4, alongside DepthSplat. In v1, UniMatch was described as a backbone component. Comparator membership in the retained experiments is unchanged.

E3.justification: The new ScanNet evaluation introduces Abs Rel, RMSE, and RMSElog metrics. Previously reported training budgets, dataset splits, resolutions, and view counts remain unchanged. ScanNet-specific splits, preprocessing, and training or checkpoint settings are not supplied.

E4.justification: New Figure 4 adds ScanNet depth-error-map comparisons examining where prediction errors occur. Component, iteration-count, and WIEA-count ablations, together with supplementary intermediate-depth visualizations, are retained unchanged apart from renumbering.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The new ScanNet table follows the existing single-value reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 1 revises IDESplat's RE10K LPIPS from 0.107 to 0.108, ACID PSNR from 29.04 to 28.94, and ACID LPIPS from 0.124 to 0.130, retaining its ranking. New ScanNet results are 0.039/0.116/0.053 for Abs Rel/RMSE/RMSElog, versus DepthSplat's 0.045/0.125/0.061 and UniMatch's 0.059/0.179/0.082. Other matched result tables are unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 3.2 corrects Equation 5 to index the original F^j features, clarifies all-ones probability initialization, and replaces Equation 8's absolute-candidate expression with explicitly defined signed offsets. It also formalizes candidate sampling and interval refinement. These are limited mathematical corrections and expansions; no proofs or theorems are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same methodological contributions and reconstruction, efficiency, and generalization claims, including the 0.33 dB RE10K and 2.95 dB DTU advantages over DepthSplat. ScanNet provides additional support without redefining the central claims.

C2.justification: Figure 2 newly explains that successive WIEA blocks use progressively refined features and therefore produce distinct probability estimates. Section 3.2 explains signed offsets as enabling symmetric depth corrections. Existing limitations concerning inference efficiency and required camera poses are retained.

D1.justification: v3 adds explicit candidate-sampling and residual-offset specifications. Removing Section 3.4 loses the explicit concatenation/convolution fusion and LePE disclosures, although most architecture details remain in Appendix B. MSE/LPIPS losses were already documented in v1's appendix, and both PDFs link to the same repository.

R1.justification: v3 adds citations to Multiview Stereo with Cascaded Epipolar RAFT and Efficient Multi-View Stereo by Iterative Dynamic Cost Volume, and removes CSWin Transformer. The broader positioning against single-warp methods and existing iterative approaches remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 rewrites portions of related work and depth-refinement explanation, drops the largely duplicated main-text architecture subsection, and lightly edits experimental discussion. It also expands an affiliation and adds an acknowledgement. The overall narrative and appendix organization remain stable.

P2.justification: v3 adds ScanNet Table 4 and Figure 4, updates Figure 2's arrows and caption, and revises labels and illustrations in the supplementary architecture schematic. Figure 3 and several tables are relocated or reflowed; existing qualitative comparisons are retained with renumbering.

improvement.justification: v3 adds direct quantitative depth evidence absent from v1, clarifies residual-depth mathematics and diagrams, and reconciles Table 1's RE10K LPIPS with the prose. These gains are limited by missing ScanNet protocol details, unreconciled interval-shrinkage and range-halving descriptions, and lost fusion/LePE documentation. Overall, the retained evidence gains modest support and clarity.
